'''Energy shells''' were [[Missile/Legends|projectiles]] fire from [[Energy shell launcher|launch tubes]] equipped on [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]]. The shells were either [[Armor/Legends|armor]]-piercing antivehicle shells or explosive "[[Bunker-buster|bunker busters]]", and were sheathed in [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] which increased the projectile's speed and penetration. AATs could carry a payload of up to fifty-five shells. To reload, the tank withdrew to a [[reload station]] where the lower portion of the AAT was removed and a fresh, fully-loaded replacement was put in its place.<ref name="NEGVV" />
